style: Stylized 3D render of a Roblox avatar character in classic Roblox avatar proportions: a cylindrical head with a simple smiley face, a blocky rectangular torso, separate blocky arms and legs with plain rectangular hands, smooth matte-plastic skin tones. It must NOT look like a LEGO minifigure: no studs on the head, no C-shaped claw hands, no minifigure legs. Dressed like Roblox catalog avatar items, with a distinct tavern-themed outfit, hat or hair, and accessories (capes, aprons, armor, wizard hats, instruments). Cozy medieval tavern setting with warm candlelight, wooden beams and amber glow, soft depth of field. Each character is a different archetype (knight, wizard, chef, bard, farmer, merchant, pirate, adventurer, and so on). If the subject is an object or place, show the avatar character proudly with it. Single subject centered with generous margin, square composition, cheerful and kid-friendly, no alcohol, no text, no letters, no logos, no Roblox logo, no frame or border
